t: King Mohammed VI appointed Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, leader of the Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM) and former mayor of Marrakesh, as Morocco's first woman Prime Minister.
The ICC named India's Shubman Gill (men's, his record fifth award) and Shafali Verma (women's) ICC Players of the Month for September 2026.
Paralympic champions Pramod Bhagat (para badminton) and Bhavina Patel (para table tennis) were named India's flag bearers for the Asian Para Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan (18-24 October).

The 17th Conference of the Parties (COP17) to the UN Convention on Biological Diversity is being held in Yerevan, Armenia, from 19 to 30 October 2026, with the first global review of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.
APEDA facilitated India's first export of organic Palmyra jaggery powder: 1.755 tonnes from Erode district, Tamil Nadu, to Varna, Bulgaria, via Chennai Port.
